title: Edit a Grammar Guide section
description: Stages an edit of one existing Grammar Guide section, given as FieldWorks Markdown, in a Draft: the whole record that guide show prints with format fw-md, or the Discussion body alone. Nothing reaches the FieldWorks project until a person applies the Draft; a Guide edit changes no word, so its Trial is exempt from the Autonomous gate. A new section is added with guide add. When the Draft already holds an edit of the section, start from guide show with asOf set to that Draft. Available in Advanced AI mode.
